S.FORM: O ilisin no Pangcah , ano pakaynien i nika sasiroma no radiw ato fodoy i, malatolo ko nika sa'etal. O no sa'amisan, o no taterongan, ato no satimolan. I tini i sa'amisan hanany i, marapot ko no'amisan no Kiyko ato Ciwidian, pasa'amis tangasa i Takidis. O taterongan hananay i, marapot ko Holin pasatimol tangasa i Kompo ko satimolan. Itini no pasawali i, marapot ko Fakong, pasatimol tangasa i Tomiyac. O notimolan hananay i , maropot ko no timolan no Fanaw ato Madawdaw a maemin tangasa i palidaw i teloc no Taywan. Nikaorira, ano malecalecad ko pikafitan i, nika sasiromaan no paniyaro'an ato wayway no finawlan saka masasiroma to ko ilisin no niyaroaro'. Pakayni i nika sasiroma no mikowanay i, kinapinapina to a mafalic ko ilisin no Pangcah. I kaRiponan ho i, o pades no mato'asay a misakoli, saka padeteng saan caira a misacecay folad a ilisin. Deng sato, yo mangatato a malowid ko Ripon i, palacecay han to a palalen a misacecay lipay ko kahalafin no ilisin. Anini sato, nika sasiroma no demak a mafalic, ira ko cecayay a romi'ad, ano tosa, roma san ira ko misatoloay to romiad a ilisin.
S.PHON: o~u iɾisin no~u paŋʦaħ , ano~u pakajniən i nika sasiro~uma no~u raɬ~ɮiw ato~u fo~uɬ~ɮo~uj i, maɾato~uɾo~u ko~u nika saʡətaɾ. o~u no~u saʡamisan, o~u no~u tatəro~uŋan, ato~u no~u satimo~uɾan. i tini i saʡamisan ħananj i, marapo~ut ko~u no~uʡamisan no~u kijko~u ato~u ʦiwiɬ~ɮian, pasaʡamis taŋasa i takiɬ~ɮis. o~u tatəro~uŋan ħananaj i, marapo~ut ko~u ħo~uɾin pasatimo~uɾ taŋasa i ko~umpo~u ko~u satimo~uɾan. itini no~u pasawaɾi i, marapo~ut ko~u fako~uŋ, pasatimo~uɾ taŋasa i to~umijaʦ. o~u no~utimo~uɾan ħananaj i , maro~upo~ut ko~u no~u timo~uɾan no~u fanaw ato~u maɬ~ɮawɬ~ɮaw a maəmin taŋasa i paɾiɬ~ɮaw i təɾo~uʦ no~u tajwan. nikao~urira, ano~u maɾəʦaɾəʦaɬ~ɮ ko~u pikafitan i, nika sasiro~umaan no~u panijaro~uʡan ato~u wajwaj no~u finawɾan saka masasiro~uma to~u ko~u iɾisin no~u nijaro~uaro~uʡ. pakajni i nika sasiro~uma no~u miko~uwanaj i, kinapinapina to~u a mafaɾiʦ ko~u iɾisin no~u paŋʦaħ. i karipo~unan ħo~u i, o~u paɬ~ɮəs no~u mato~uʡasaj a misako~uɾi, saka paɬ~ɮətəŋ saan ʦaira a misaʦəʦaj fo~uɾaɬ~ɮ a iɾisin. ɬ~ɮəŋ sato~u, jo~u maŋatato~u a maɾo~uwiɬ~ɮ ko~u ripo~un i, paɾaʦəʦaj ħan to~u a paɾaɾən a misaʦəʦaj ɾipaj ko~u kaħaɾafin no~u iɾisin. anini sato~u, nika sasiro~uma no~u ɬ~ɮəmak a mafaɾiʦ, ira ko~u ʦəʦajaj a ro~umiʡaɬ~ɮ, ano~u to~usa, ro~uma san ira ko~u misato~uɾo~uaj to~u ro~umiaɬ~ɮ a iɾisin.
